description: Department of Agrarian Development - Notify the rent to be paid for Paddy Cultivation and other agricultural crop, by the tenant cultivation to the landlord
reasoning: This gazette notification contains a determination made under the Agrarian Development Act, No. 46 of 2000 (as amended), which establishes regulatory requirements for agricultural land rents. It falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves the implementation and enforcement of existing legislation, specifically setting rent amounts for paddy cultivation and other agricultural crops across different regions and irrigation systems. While it mentions a government official (Commissioner General of Agrarian Development), this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
